name: Charles P. Monroe
basis: one of the four members of color the passage names; it counts three Black men and one Hispanic man without saying which is which
quote: “As of the writing of this piece, 3 black men, one Hispanic man, and no Asian American people have served on the Arlington County Board under the at-large system. It should also be noted that all four board members of color in the at-large era were elected in years where two county board seats were up for election, and only Christian Dorsey in 2015 managed to gain office by winning the most amount of votes, rather than the second amount of votes. Had William T. Neuman, Charles Monroe, or Walter Tejada ran in any other election cycle, they would have lost.”
